summary: Test asserts real focus, real single-step cycling (claude->codex matching sorted(HARNESSES)), and fake.created==[] post-Enter over an unmocked Textual key-dispatch path; verified by injected counterexamples: disabling the widget's shadowing binding lets Enter fall through and populate fake.created (caught by the ==[] assertion), and a no-op action_cycle leaves value at 'claude' (caught by the =='codex' assertion).
